records.observation: Uses clogTOdrawable InputLog, not clog2TOdrawable. Main initializes category/shadow maps and trunk; dispatch by Kind identity handles topology, category and primitive only, no YCoordMap or Composite branch. Shadow map is shared and populated after trunk construction. Primitive category resolution return ignored, count incremented, optional time check then add. Default checks false; -tc exits on first primitive/order violation, -tcc continues; no sorting or finite-value guard. Unknown kind logs and loops without consumption here. EOF flush success removes unused categories, writes category map, constructs LineIDMapList containing only trunk identity map, writes it, closes output then input; stats queried after input close. Empty flush closes then attempts output deletion ignoring result, exits1. No finally for abnormal exits. Main resets output, parser resets input/check flags but not numeric static values. Positive -nc/-ls overrides applied; zero/negative ignored. parseByteSize chooses k/K index>0 before m/M, parses preceding integer, ignores trailing text, multiplies unchecked int. Help exits0; unknown option exits1; last positional input wins; output trimmed and suffix only warned. Missing operand/number exceptions print then may return normally if prior input nonnull. No same input/output guard. Ordinal helper only special-cases1/2/3. Help usage names slog2.output.Clog2Slog despite class ClogToSlog2; stored discrepancy preserved.
